item.title: The Pretty Reckless Release ‘Dear God,’ Title Track From Upcoming Fifth Album
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's music update. Today, we're talking about The Pretty Reckless, who just dropped their latest single, "Dear God". This track is the title song from their upcoming fifth studio album, set to release on June 26th via Fearless Records.
[Soft music transition]
Host: "Dear God" is the band's fourth single from the album, following hits like "For I Am Death", which became their eighth number one on Billboard's Mainstream Rock Airplay chart. That's a record for any woman-fronted act in the chart's history. The new track takes a different approach, with a slow-building sound and haunting vocals from Taylor Momsen.
[Clip of "Dear God" plays in the background]
Host: Taylor Momsen describes "Dear God" as "desperation set to music". The song's lyrics convey a desperate plea for escape, and the album as a whole is said to be the band's most emotionally raw and uncompromising record to date.
[Soft music continues]
Host: The Pretty Reckless have had an exciting stretch recently, having completed a two-year tour with AC/DC, performed with Soundgarden, and appeared at the MusiCares Person of the Year Gala. They're also set to embark on a headlining world tour in support of the new album, with dates announced in North America and Europe.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. The Pretty Reckless' new album, "Dear God", is out on June 26th. Catch them on tour and get ready for what promises to be an unforgettable musical experience. Thanks for tuning in!
